name: mclovin
author: Guilherme Yamakawa de Oliveira
description: Choose which browser opens every link. A picker in the middle of the screen, one row per profile, and rules that send a link to a browser, a web app, or another application. An optional Chromium extension catches the clicks a rule sends out of the browser.

barWidget.description: Shows whether mclovin is handling links; click for stats, rules, and the browser picker.

schema.label: Show today's link count next to the icon
